model_metadata:
### Model stg_customers
File: models/staging/stg_customers.sql · materialized as view
Description: Cleaned customers, one row per customer. Email lower-cased, country code upper-cased.
Columns (name · type in warehouse · description · tests):
- customer_id · INTEGER · Primary key of the customer. · tests: unique, not_null
- first_name · VARCHAR · Customer first name.
- last_name · VARCHAR · Customer last name.
- email · VARCHAR · Lower-cased email address. A small share of missing emails is tolerated (max 5%). · tests: null_rate_below(max_rate=0.05)
- country_code · VARCHAR · Upper-cased ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (from raw_customers.country). · tests: not_null
- created_at · TIMESTAMP · UTC timestamp when the account was created.
- loaded_at · TIMESTAMP · UTC timestamp when the row was loaded into the warehouse.
SQL (models/staging/stg_customers.sql):
```sql
with source as (

    select * from {{ source('raw', 'raw_customers') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        customer_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        lower(email) as email,
        upper(country) as country_code,
        cast(created_at as timestamp) as created_at,
        loaded_at
    from source

)

select * from renamed
```

historical_context:
Recent changes (newest first):
- 2026-10-11 · ticket · PRIV-31: CRM admin enabled 'EU privacy mode' on the customer export integration.
- 2026-10-01 · commit 3f2d318 · stg_customers: lower-case email and upper-case country code (models/staging/stg_customers.sql)
- 2026-09-30 · deploy · CRM connector upgraded 3.1 → 3.2 (bug-fix release)
Previous incidents:
- INC-0377 (2026-08-26): email null rate reached 3.1% after bulk sign-ups without email. Resolution: null-rate threshold for stg_customers.email set to 5%.
Recent run history:
- Email null rate in stg_customers, last 7 daily runs: 0.0%, 0.0%, 0.5%, 0.0%, 0.0%, 0.0%, 17.5% today (2026-10-13).

gold_standard_remediation.root_cause: All 35 null emails (17.5% of 200 customers) belong to customers with country_code DE or NL. That matches the 'EU privacy mode' enabled on the CRM export two days ago (PRIV-31): the export now blanks email for these customers. This is a deliberate upstream change, not a dbt bug, so null_rate_below on stg_customers.email (max 5%) now fails.
gold_standard_remediation.fix: Confirm the pattern: `select country_code, count(*) filter (where email is null) as null_emails, count(*) from stg_customers group by 1`. Check with the CRM admin and the data-protection owner that suppressing these emails is intended. If it is, scope the test in models/staging/schema.yml to the unaffected countries: add `config: {where: "country_code not in ('DE', 'NL')"}` to the null_rate_below test, and document in the email column description that DE/NL emails are suppressed. Tell the marketing dashboard owners. If it is not intended, ask the CRM admin to switch privacy mode off and re-run the export. Do not backfill emails from another system.
gold_standard_remediation.verification: `dbt build --select stg_customers+` passes, the scoped null rate is at most 5%, and every remaining null email belongs to a DE or NL customer.
